items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: did anybody in Bali Bolton's band sing this tune?

ctx.x: Could you sing it? Can you sing the song at all? Huh? Can you sing the song? No. I just thought I'd hum a little bit along so that we can get an idea about it. No. You're not a singer, huh?

No. Well, did anybody in Bali Bolton's band sing this tune? No, no. They didn't sing nothing. They didn't sing them. They didn't sing them. Sometimes. They always had somebody that haunts something. How about the little children around here? Did they pick up the tune and sing? Yeah. Did they used to sing? Yeah.
